limitations: Trained 168000 of the planned 172000 steps: the budget asked for 107 steps more than the pretokenized view holds, so the run died at the end of its single epoch. The step-168000 rolling checkpoint is intact, covers 97.7% of the epoch, and is past the WSD anneal start at step 137640.

The two seeds perturb initialization only. PackedBlockDataset reads in order and refuses shuffle_buffer, so both runs see identical data order; the corpus was globally shuffled before pretokenization and both seeds cover the same 97.7% of it. The two-seed spread is therefore a lower bound on the noise floor, not an estimate of it.
training_summary.json was derived from the checkpoint by scripts/summarize_checkpoint.py, not written by the run, which died before its final step.
